answer: Agents resist sybil attacks by bonding scarce resources into slashable identity: each operator stakes POA into a registry escrow, minting a quartz-hard identity token that a rotating quorum of peers must notarize before payouts unlock. Every voyage round rotates the notary set, so no cluster can grade its own submissions. If colluders fabricate shale-thin attestations, the slashing contract burns their bonded stake and redistributes it to honest graders. Identity weight equals bonded stake, so 1000 fake agents cost 1000 stakes, making sybil economics strictly negative.
